descriptionHtml:
Redragon KG010-KN Brown Switch Mechanical Gaming Keyboard


**Brand:** Redragon

**Model:** KG010-KN

**Type:** Wired Mechanical Gaming Keyboard

**Color:** Black

**Form Factor:** Full Size (104/105 keys)

**Switch Type:** Brown Tactile Switches (Outemu or equivalent)


---


**Physical Specifications:**

Dimensions (L x W x H): 447 x 184 x 35 mm (approx.)

Weight: 1150g (approx. 2.5 lbs)

Material: Aluminum top plate + ABS plastic base

LED Backlighting: Single Color (Blue or RGB depending on variant)

Battery: N/A (wired only)


---


**Switches:**

Switch Type: Brown Tactile

Switch Brand: Outemu

Operating Force: 55g ± 10g

Travel Distance: 4.0 mm

Actuation Point: 2.0 mm

Tactile Feedback: Yes (medium tactile bump)

Click Sound: No (quiet tactile, not clicky)

Lifecycle: 50 million keystrokes


---


**Connectivity:**

Connection Type: Wired

Interface: USB 2.0 / 3.0

Cable Type: Braided USB cable

Cable Length: 1.8 meters (approx. 6 feet)

Detachable Cable: No

USB Passthrough: No

Audio Passthrough: No


---


**Key Features:**

N-Key Rollover (NKRO): Yes (full anti-ghosting)

Multimedia Keys: Yes (via Fn key combination)

Windows Key Disable: Yes

Polling Rate: 1000 Hz (1ms response time)

Onboard Memory: No

Macro Support: No (no dedicated software)

Mechanical Switches: Yes (hot-swappable? No, soldered)


---


**Backlighting:**

Backlight Type: LED (single color - Blue or RGB depending on version)

Lighting Modes: Multiple patterns (breathing, wave, static, etc.)

Brightness Control: Yes (adjustable levels)

Per-Key Lighting: No (preset zones)

Software Control: No (hardware controlled via Fn keys)


---


**Software:**

Dedicated Software: No (plug and play)

Driver Required: No


---


**Compatibility:**

Operating Systems:

- Windows XP/Vista/7/8/10/11

- macOS (basic functions only)

- Linux (basic functions only)

---


**Package Includes:**

Redragon KG010-KN Mechanical Keyboard

User Manual

Keycap Puller (depending on version)

Redragon Stickers


---


**Pros:**

Full size layout with number pad

Durable aluminum top plate

Brown tactile switches (quiet, good for typing and gaming)

N-Key rollover (1000 Hz polling rate)

Braided USB cable

Affordable price

No software needed (plug and play)

---


**Ideal For:**

Office work and typing (quiet tactile feel)

Budget gamers

Users who want full size keyboard

First-time mechanical keyboard users

Programming and data entry

Users who prefer no software bloat


---


**Warranty:** 1 years
